_about: Play Data safety answers for the Android app (com.universalsim.extender). Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Screens/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Screens/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Checked against the code 2026-10-20: the screen, input and device name go peer to peer on the LAN, end-to-end encrypted with the PIN (Noise), never to UNI·SIM. Remote codes and Cast to a browser pass through the opensource.unisim.co.uk rendezvous relay, which forwards messages and stores nothing (remote sessions are end-to-end encrypted; cast commands are TLS-encrypted and processed ephemerally), so not declared as collected. No user count, analytics or crash reporting in the Android app (UserCount.kt removed 2026-10-12). No sign-in and no accounts since 2026-10-20 (Account.kt / AccountUi.kt removed; the saved-computer sync to screens_saved_hosts went with them, and prod held 0 rows): saved computers move between devices only as a file the user saves and opens themselves (SavedFile.kt, the suite transfer envelope, never the PIN), which never reaches UNI·SIM. So: no data collected. Re-import this at the next Play release, and set App access to no special access. Mirrors PRIVACY.md and apps/ios/ScreenExtender/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
